facts: [cpu] reason I_KRR_NO_DATA (info): KRR gave no cpu recommendation (Not enough data); using this tool's own figure instead.
[cpu] reason S_USAGE_ABOVE_REQUEST (support): p95 CPU 0.585 cores is above the request 0.200 cores.
[memory] reason I_KRR_NO_DATA (info): KRR gave no memory recommendation (Not enough data); using this tool's own figure instead.
[memory] reason I_FLOOR (info): Candidate 6Mi is below the minimum 32Mi; using the minimum.
limitation: Workload name is inferred from the pod name.
limitation: Revisions are not tracked, so samples from different releases are mixed.
limitation: Usage figures are the highest value across pods (conservative).
limitation: p50/p95/max use a 5-minute CPU rate; peak_1m uses a 1-minute rate and is still limited by the scrape interval.
limitation: No latency, error-rate or SLO data is included.
limitation: History covers about 0.3 h of the requested 3.0 h window.
limitation: Workload runs intermittently: 0.1 h of samples across a 0.3 h span; percentiles describe only the time it was running.
limitation: CPU throttling ratio unavailable: no CPU limit is enforced, or the cAdvisor throttling metrics are missing.

parsed.headline: batch-periodic: increase CPU is supported, memory can be reduced

cpu.explanation: CPU request can be increased from 0.200 cores to 0.585 cores (192% increase). The p95 CPU usage of 0.585 cores is above the current request, supporting this change.

memory.explanation: Memory request can be reduced from 64Mi to 32Mi (50% decrease). The candidate request was 6Mi, but it was adjusted to the minimum floor of 32Mi.

caveats: History covers about 0.3 h of the requested 3.0 h window.
Workload runs intermittently: 0.1 h of samples across a 0.3 h span; percentiles describe only the time it was running.
